what: Seller reports experiencing high views (800–1,000 by morning) but zero sales during November 2025, despite running a 15% shop sale, describing November as their worst month of the year when it should have been the best.
verbatim_snippet: "Something is definitely going on, I have experienced just the opposite but with no sales. My views and visits have gone through the roof at 800 to a 1,000 by 7:00 in the morning, with a 15% sale off in my shop and no sales. This is the worst time of the year this could happen. I don't know what is happening to my shop but I'm not happy because I'm not making any sales. November was the worst month I had this year and it should have been the best.?????"
notes: community.etsy.com requires login. Content retrieved from Google search index. 800–1,000 views/visits by 7:00 AM, zero sales. 15% shop-wide sale active. November 2025. References Black Friday/Cyber Monday period. Thread context: multiple sellers reporting similar patterns.
